## Suggested order rationale (short)

1. **Borrowed storefronts / catalogs first** (Gumroad → HF → PyPI → npm → Kaggle) — audiences already browse for paid packs / datasets / packages; low ceremony once live verify passes.
2. **Launch boards mid-morning** (Product Hunt → Show HN → Indie Hackers → Lobsters) — PH favors early US Friday; Show HN / IH / Lobsters work better when live Note + Stripe are proven and storefronts exist as proof points.
3. **Longer articles next** (Dev.to → Hashnode → Medium → Substack) — after listings and launch posts so links and CTAs resolve cleanly.
4. **General social later** (Twitter/X → Bluesky → Mastodon → LinkedIn → Threads → Facebook) — amplify once Sample + Stripe + at least one listing/launch post are live; shorter copy, faster to defer if morning slips.
5. **Trader / community fold-in last** (TradingView → StockTwits → YouTube Community) — futures/COT-native audiences; run after Sample + Stripe verify and after at least one storefront or launch board is live so CTAs resolve. Place after general social so morning bandwidth goes to high-leverage rails first; defer any without Benjamin go.

Reorder if Benjamin prefers; the gate is still one explicit go per channel. **No authorize to post** from this file alone.
